# Kvitok

> Kvitok is an open-source, self-hosted customer support system (helpdesk) with an AI agent. Requests come in by email or over an API. The agent reads the customer's data in your backend through a small signed HTTP protocol, picks a department, drafts a reply and proposes actions such as crediting points, issuing a coupon or cancelling an order. An operator talks it over with the agent in the ticket and approves each action; your backend validates it again and executes it once per idempotency key.

Kvitok fits teams whose support requests change data in their own systems: loyalty programs, online shops, subscriptions, internal tools. It is licensed under AGPL-3.0; the protocol package and the reference backend are MIT. It runs from one Docker image with PostgreSQL and Redis and works with any OpenAI-compatible model with tool calling (OpenAI, OpenRouter, LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama). An MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor or another MCP client connect a backend, configure a workspace and tune the agent. Kvitok is in early development and has not run in production yet; it has no chat widget, help center or SLAs, and every action waits for a person.

Compared with Zendesk AI agents, Intercom Fin and Freshdesk Freddy AI, Kvitok is self-hosted, has no fee per resolution and keeps a person in the loop for every action. Compared with Chatwoot and Zammad, it centers on an agent that investigates in your backend and proposes typed, validated actions.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Rogue85/kvitok/blob/main/README.md): what Kvitok does, how it works, getting started
- [Support Action Protocol](https://github.com/Rogue85/kvitok/blob/main/docs/protocol.md): the endpoints a backend implements, signing, the manifest, actions, option sets
- [MCP server](https://github.com/Rogue85/kvitok/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): configuring and tuning Kvitok from an external agent, the Claude Code plugin
- [Deployment](https://github.com/Rogue85/kvitok/blob/main/docs/deployment.md): running in production from the Docker image
- [Development](https://github.com/Rogue85/kvitok/blob/main/docs/development.md): the development stack, the coffee shop simulator, agent evaluation
- [Changelog](https://github.com/Rogue85/kvitok/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what each release changed
